title: Interactive Origami Tutorials | Origami Penguin
heading: Interactive Origami Tutorials
description: Learn sixteen paper and U.S. dollar bill origami projects with step-by-step drag-to-fold instructions.
body:
Choose a paper or dollar bill project. Drag the green point into the outlined target. When the fold lines up, you’ll see the result and move to the next step automatically. Use Step Back to repeat a step.

Paper projects

U.S. Dollar Bill Origami

Start with one bill for each project.

Try this fold with real paper

Browse illustrated tutorials
